name: wrongbook-ios
description: Native iOS packaging for the Wrong Book web app.

scripts.ios:add: npm run prepare:ios-web && npx cap add ios && npm run ios:configure && npm run ios:assets
scripts.ios:sync: npm run prepare:ios-web && npx cap sync ios && npm run ios:configure && npm run ios:assets
scripts.ios:open: npm run ios:sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.ios:run: npm run ios:sync && npx cap run ios
